steps.title: Analyze App Requirements and Dependencies
steps.description: Establish build configuration, Temurin 17 compatibility, and core app configurations for VarshaLaxmi.

steps.title: Configure Application Package and Manifest
steps.description: Set application theme, export MainActivity, and specify launcher entry filters.

steps.title: Design Emerald & Gold Color Palette & Resources
steps.description: Define color palette, string localization tokens (EN/HI), cards, and button styles.

steps.title: Create Customer Data Model
steps.description: Implement Customer model with total given, collected, and outstanding ledger balance properties.

steps.title: Create Loan and Top-Up Addition Models
steps.description: Implement Loan and LoanAddition models supporting initial principal, interest rates, and top-ups.

steps.title: Create Payment & Period Breakdown Models
steps.description: Implement Payment, PeriodBreakdownItem, and PeriodBreakdownResult models for calculation reporting.

steps.title: Implement Interest Calculation Engine
steps.description: Build offline interest engine for daily and monthly compound/simple calculations across top-up milestones.

steps.title: Develop SQLite Database Helper & Schema Operations
steps.description: Create SQLite database schema for customers, loans, additions, payments, and application settings.

steps.title: Implement Backup & Restore Storage Utilities
steps.description: Create Storage Access Framework helper for ZIP archive backup generation and data restoration.

steps.title: Design Card, List, & Dialog User Interfaces
steps.description: Build XML layouts for customer list cards, active loan cards, payment items, dialogs, and breakdown views.

steps.title: Implement Main Controller and Dynamic Viewport Navigation
steps.description: Wire dashboard stats, customer search, tab navigation, language switcher, and live interest preview dialog.

steps.title: Building VarshaLaxmi
steps.description: Compile final APK with multi-period interest breakdown and live preview engine.
